paragraphs: Unless the context otherwise requires, references to "Expand Energy," the "Company," "us," "we," "our" and "ours" in this report are to Expand Energy Corporation together with its subsidiaries. Our principal executive offices are located at 6100 North Western Avenue, Oklahoma City, Oklahoma 73118, and our main telephone number at that location is (405) 848-8000.

Expand Energy is the largest independent natural gas producer in the U.S., based on net daily production, and is focused on responsibly developing an abundant supply of natural gas, oil and NGL to expand energy access for all. Our operations are located in Louisiana and Texas in the Haynesville and Bossier Shales ("Haynesville"), in Pennsylvania in the Marcellus Shale ("Northeast Appalachia") and in West Virginia and Ohio in the Marcellus and Utica Shales ("Southwest Appalachia") and include working interests in approximately 6,600 gross natural gas and oil wells.

On October 1, 2024, we completed the Southwestern Merger, creating a premier energy company that we believe is underpinned by a leading natural gas portfolio adjacent to the highest demand markets, premium inventory, a resilient financial foundation and an investment grade balance sheet. We believe that we are uniquely positioned to deliver affordable, lower-carbon energy to meet growing domestic and international demand while creating sustainable value for stakeholders. Since completing our merger with Southwestern, we've continued to focus on strengthening our balance sheet by reducing total debt by approximately $1.2 billion and upsized our 2025 Credit Facility capacity to $3.5 billion. In 2025, we joined the S&P 500 index and returned approximately $865 million to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases.

We make available, free of charge on our website at expandenergy.com, our annual reports on Form 10-K, quarterly reports on Form 10-Q, current reports on Form 8-K, and any amendments to those reports as soon as reasonably practicable after we electronically file such material with, or furnish it to, the SEC. From time to time, we also post announcements, updates, events, investor information and presentations on our website in addition to copies of all recent news releases. Documents and information on our website are not incorporated by reference herein.

The SEC maintains a website at www.sec.gov that contains reports, proxy and information statements, and other information regarding issuers, including Expand Energy, that file electronically with the SEC.

Our strategy is to create resilient shareholder value through the responsible development of our significant resource plays while continuing to be a leading provider of natural gas to growing markets. We continue to focus on improving margins through operating efficiencies, marketing and commercial efforts and financial discipline and improving our safety and sustainability performance. To accomplish these goals, we plan to allocate our human resources and capital expenditures to projects we believe offer the highest cash return on capital invested, to deploy leading drilling and completion technology throughout our portfolio, and to take advantage of acquisition and divestiture opportunities to strengthen our portfolio. We also intend to continue to invest in projects designed to reduce the environmental impact of our production activities.
We focus our acquisition, exploration, development and production efforts in the geographic operating areas described below.
Haynesville - Haynesville and Bossier Shales in Louisiana and Texas.
Northeast Appalachia - Marcellus Shale in Pennsylvania.
Southwest Appalachia - Marcellus and Utica Shales in Ohio and West Virginia. Well Data

As of December 31, 2025, we held a working interest in approximately 6,600 (4,600 net) wells of which substantially all were classified as productive natural gas wells. We also completed 272 gross (202 net) wells as operator and participated in another 39 gross (1 net) well completed by other operators. headings: Risks Related to Operating our Business
Natural gas, oil and NGL prices fluctuate widely, and lower prices for an extended period of time are likely to have a material adverse effect on our business.
Conservation measures and technological advances could reduce demand for natural gas and oil.
Negative public perception regarding us or our industry could have an adverse effect on our operations.
Risks related to potential acquisitions or dispositions may adversely affect our business.
If commodity prices fall or drilling efforts are unsuccessful, we may be required to record write-downs of the carrying value of our natural gas and oil properties.
Significant capital expenditures are required to replace our reserves and conduct our business.
If we are not able to replace reserves, we may not be able to sustain production.
The actual quantities of and future net revenues from our proved reserves may be less than our estimates.
Our development and exploratory drilling efforts and our well operations may not be profitable or achieve our targeted returns.
Certain of our undeveloped properties are subject to leases that will expire over the next several years unless production is established on units containing the acreage or the leases are renewed.
Natural gas and oil operations are uncertain and involve substantial costs and risks.
Our operations may be adversely affected by pipeline, trucking and gathering system capacity constraints and may be subject to interruptions that could adversely affect our cash flow.
The departure of key management personnel and the failure to attract and retain talent could adversely affect our operations.

Our business is subject to risks related to catastrophes, natural disasters, severe weather and human causes beyond our control, which may have a negative impact on our results of operations and financial condition.
A deterioration in general economic, political, business or industry conditions would have a material adverse effect on our results of operations, liquidity and financial condition.
We may be unable to dispose of assets on attractive terms, and may be required to retain liabilities for certain matters.

Military and other armed conflicts, including terrorist activities, and related price volatility and geopolitical instability could materially and adversely affect our business and results of operations.
Financial Risks Related to our Business
We have significant capital needs, and our ability to access the capital and credit markets to raise capital on favorable terms is limited by industry conditions.
paragraphs: There are numerous factors that affect our business and results of operations, many of which are beyond our control. The following is a description of factors that we consider to be material and that might cause our future results to differ materially from those currently expected. The risks described below are not the only risks facing our company. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial may also affect our business operations. If any of these risks actually occur, our business, financial position, results of operations, cash flows, reserves and/or our ability to pay our debts and other liabilities could suffer, the trading price and liquidity of our securities could decline and you may lose all or part of your investment in our securities.

Our revenues, results of operations, profitability, liquidity, leverage ratio and ability to grow and invest in capital expenditures depend primarily upon the prices we receive for the natural gas, oil and NGL we sell. We incur substantial expenditures to replace reserves, sustain production and fund our business plans. Low natural gas, oil and NGL prices can negatively affect the amount of cash available for capital expenditures, debt service and debt repayment and our ability to borrow money or raise additional capital and, as a result, could have a material adverse effect on our financial condition, results of operations, cash flows and reserves. In addition, periods of low natural gas and oil prices may result in a reduction of the carrying value of our natural gas and oil properties due to recognizing impairments in proved and unproved properties.
Volatility in natural gas, oil and NGL prices may result from factors that are beyond our control, including:
•domestic and worldwide supplies of natural gas, oil and NGL, including U.S. inventories of natural gas and oil reserves;
•changes in the level of consumer and industrial demand, including impacts from global or national health events and concerns;
•the price and availability of alternative fuels; •technological advances affecting energy consumption;

paragraphs: This Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations is intended to provide a reader of our financial statements with management's perspective on our financial condition, liquidity, results of operations and certain other factors that may affect our future results. This information is intended to provide investors with an understanding of our past performance, current financial condition and outlook for the future and should be read in conjunction with Item 8 of Part II of this report.

On October 1, 2024, we completed the Southwestern Merger, creating a premier energy company that we believe is underpinned by a leading natural gas portfolio adjacent to the highest demand markets, premium inventory, a resilient financial foundation and an investment grade balance sheet. We believe that this new company is uniquely positioned to deliver affordable, lower-carbon energy to meet growing domestic and international demand while creating sustainable value for stakeholders. In conjunction with the closing of the Southwestern Merger, Chesapeake Energy Corporation changed its name to Expand Energy Corporation.

Expand Energy is the largest independent natural gas producer in the U.S., based on net daily production, and is focused on responsibly developing an abundant supply of natural gas, oil and NGL to expand energy access for all. Our operations are located in Louisiana and Texas in the Haynesville and Bossier Shales ("Haynesville"), in Pennsylvania in the Marcellus Shale ("Northeast Appalachia") and in West Virginia and Ohio in the Marcellus and Utica Shales ("Southwest Appalachia").

Our strategy is to create resilient shareholder value through the responsible development of our significant resource plays while continuing to be a leading provider of natural gas to growing markets. We continue to focus on improving margins through operating efficiencies, marketing and commercial efforts and financial discipline and improving our safety and sustainability performance. To accomplish these goals, we plan to allocate our human resources and capital expenditures to projects we believe offer the highest cash return on capital invested, to deploy leading drilling and completion technology throughout our portfolio, and to take advantage of acquisition and divestiture opportunities to strengthen our portfolio. We also intend to continue to invest in projects designed to reduce the environmental impact of our production activities.
Additionally, we aim to be conscientious in our efforts and how they will shape our approach to sustainability for the future and have established the following goals:
•Net zero (Scope 1 and 2) greenhouse gas emissions by 2035.
•Maintain 100% responsibly sourced gas (RSG) certification across our portfolio.

On October 1, 2024, we completed the Southwestern Merger and issued approximately 95.7 million shares of our common stock to Southwestern's shareholders in connection with the Merger Agreement. Under the terms of the Merger Agreement, subject to certain exceptions, each share of Southwestern common stock was converted into the right to receive 0.0867 of a share of the Company's common stock. Based on the closing price of our common stock, the total value of such shares of our common stock issued to Southwestern's shareholders was approximately $7.9 billion. See Note 2 of the notes to our consolidated financial statements included in Item 8 of Part II of this report for further discussion.

On October 1, 2024, we received an investment grade rating from S&P Global Ratings ("S&P"). S&P assigned an issuer-level rating of ‘BBB-' on our unsecured debt and raised our issuer credit rating to ‘BBB-', with a stable outlook. Additionally, on October 2, 2024, we received an investment grade rating from Fitch Ratings ("Fitch"). Fitch affirmed our revolver credit rating at ‘BBB-' and upgraded the rating on our senior notes to ‘BBB-', with a stable outlook. Additionally, on April 16, 2025, we received an investment grade rating from Moody's Ratings ("Moody's"). Moody's upgraded the rating on our senior unsecured notes from Ba1 to Baa3, with a stable outlook.
In March 2025, following the close of the Southwestern Merger and the receipt of investment grade ratings, our common stock was added to the S&P 500.

On September 30, 2025, the Company entered into an Amended and Restated Credit Agreement that, among other things, extended the 2025 Credit Facility's maturity date from December 2027 to September 2030, with two one-year extension options available, each subject to the Lenders' consent, increased the aggregate commitments under the 2025 Credit Facility from $2.5 billion to $3.5 billion with incremental capacity for additional commitments in an amount up to $1.0 billion, subject to the receipt of commitments thereto and certain customary conditions. The Credit Agreement also increased the sublimit available for the issuance of letters of credit from $500 million to $1.0 billion and increased the sublimit available for swingline loans from $50 million to $100 million. See Note 4 of the notes to our consolidated financial statements included in Item 8 of Part II of this report for further discussion.
Issuance of Senior Notes and Senior Notes Repayment

In December 2024, we completed our underwritten public offering of $750 million aggregate principal amount of our 5.70% Senior Notes due 2035 (the "2035 Notes"). Additionally, we announced an offer to purchase for cash, any and all of our outstanding 2026 Notes (the "Tender Offer"). Upon expiration of the Tender Offer, approximately 91%, or $453 million, of the 2026 Notes were validly tendered and not validly withdrawn. In a separate transaction during the fourth quarter of 2024, we redeemed all of the $304 million aggregate principal of the SWN 2028 Notes for approximately $312 million, which included an $8 million premium to call the notes.

In January 2025, the $389 million aggregate principal of the SWN 2025 Notes was repaid and terminated with cash on hand and borrowings on the Prior Credit Facility. Additionally, in March 2025, we redeemed the remaining $47 million aggregate principal of the 2026 Notes with cash on hand. During 2025, we also redeemed approximately $103 million of our 6.750% Senior Notes due 2029, approximately $60 million of our 5.875% Senior Notes due 2029 and approximately $62 million of our 5.375% Senior Notes due 2029 through open market repurchases using cash on hand. See Note 4 of the notes to our consolidated financial statements included in Item 8 of Part II of this report for further discussion.

paragraphs: 除非文意另有所指，否則本報告中提及 "Expand Energy"、"本公司"、"我們"、"我們的" 及 "我們的" 均指 Expand Energy Corporation 連同其子公司。本公司主要營業據點位於 Oklahoma City, Oklahoma 73118 的 6100 North Western Avenue，該處之主要電話號碼為 (405) 848-8000。

Expand Energy 是根據淨日產量計算，美國最大的獨立天然氣生產商，專注於負責任地開發豐富的天然氣、石油與 NGL，以擴展所有人的能源存取。我們的營運地點位於 Louisiana 和 Texas 的 Haynesville 和 Bossier Shales（"Haynesville"），Pennsylvania 的 Marcellus Shale（"Northeast Appalachia"），以及 West Virginia 和 Ohio 的 Marcellus 和 Utica Shales（"Southwest Appalachia"），並持有約 6,600 口天然氣與石油井的權益。

我們於 2024 年 10 月 1 日完成 Southwestern Merger，成立了一家我們認為具備領先天然氣資產、鄰近最高需求市場、優質存貨、強韌財務基礎與投資等級資產負債表的頂級能源公司。我們相信，我們獨特的定位能提供可負擔且低碳的能源，以應對日益增長的國內與國際需求，同時為股東創造可持續的價值。自與 Southwestern 完成合併後，我們持續專注於強化資產負債表，將總負債減少約 12 億美元，並將 2025 年信用融資能力擴大至 35 億美元。2025 年，我們加入了 S&P 500 指數，並透過股息與股票回購，向股東回饋約 8.65 億美元。
我們在 expandenergy.com 網站上免費提供年度報告（Form 10-K）、季報（Form 10-Q）、現況報告（Form 8-K）及這些報告的任何更正版本，於我們電子提交至 SEC 或提供給 SEC 後盡速公開。我們偶爾也會在網站上張貼公告、更新資訊、活動、投資者資訊與簡報，以及所有近期新聞稿的副本。網站上的文件與資訊並未於本文件中引用。
SEC 的網站為 www.sec.gov，包含發電商（包括 Expand Energy）提交至 SEC 的報告、股東資訊聲明及其他資訊。

我們的策略是透過負責任地開發我們的重大資源區塊，創造韌性股東價值，同時持續作為天然氣主要供應商，服務成長中的市場。我們持續專注於透過營運效率、行銷與商業努力及財務紀律來改善毛利率，並提升我們的安全與永續表現。為達成這些目標，我們計畫將人力與資本支出分配至我們認為能提供最高現金回報的項目，於我們的資產組閤中部署領先的鑽井與完井技術，並利用收購與出售機會來強化資產組合。我們也計畫持續投資於能降低我們生產活動環境影響的項目。
我們的收購、探勘、開發與生產努力均聚焦於以下地理營運區域。
Haynesville - Louisiana 和 Texas 的 Haynesville 和 Bossier Shales（"Haynesville"）
東北阿巴拉契亞 - 美國賓夕法尼亞州的馬瑟爾斯頁巖。
西南阿巴拉契亞 - 美國俄亥俄州與西維吉尼亞州的馬瑟爾斯與尤蒂卡頁巖。井資料

paragraphs: 本項管理層討論與分析財務狀況及營運成果，旨在為財務報表的閱覽者提供管理層對本公司財務狀況、流動性、營運成果及可能影響未來營運成果之其他因素的觀點。此資訊旨在讓投資人瞭解本公司過去之營運表現、目前財務狀況及未來展望，應與本報告第二部分第 8 項內容一併閱讀。

於 2024 年 10 月 1 日，本公司完成西南合併，成立一家首屈一指的能源公司，本公司認為該公司擁有領先的天然氣資產組合，位於需求最高的市場附近，並擁有高價值存貨、強韌的財務基礎及投資等級資產負債表。本公司相信此新公司獨特地處於可提供負擔得起、低碳排放能源以應對國內外日益增長需求，同時為股東創造可持續價值之優勢。配合西南合併之完成， Chesapeake Energy Corporation 更名為 Expand Energy Corporation。

Expand Energy 是美國最大的獨立天然氣生產商，以淨日產量為基準，並專注於負責任地開發豐富的天然氣、石油及 NGL 來擴大能源存取。本公司之營運位於路易斯安那州與德克薩斯州之 Haynesville 及 Bossier 石灰岩區（"Haynesville"），賓州之 Marcellus 石灰岩區（"Northeast Appalachia"），以及西維吉尼亞州與俄亥俄州之 Marcellus 及 Utica 石灰岩區（"Southwest Appalachia"）。

本公司策略為透過負責任地開發本公司重要資源區塊，創造強韌之股東價值，同時持續為成長市場提供天然氣。本公司持續著重於透過營運效率、行銷及商業努力與財務紀律來提升毛利率，並改善安全與永續性表現。為達成這些目標，本公司計畫將人力資源與資本支出分配至我們認為能提供最高現金回報率之項目，於全資產組閤中部署領先的鑽井與完井技術，並利用收購與出售機會來強化資產組合。本公司亦計畫持續投資於設計用以降低生產活動環境影響之項目。
此外，本公司旨在於努力方式上保持謹慎，並塑造未來永續性之方法，已建立以下目標：
•至 2035 年實現淨零（範疇 1 與 2）溫室氣體排放。
•維持全資產組合 100% 責任來源天然氣（RSG）認證。
於 2024 年 10 月 1 日，本公司完成西南合併，並根據合併協議發行約 95.7 萬股本公司普通股，作為對西南股東之發行。根據合併協議條款（除特定例外情況外），每一股西南普通股轉換為取得本公司 0.0867 股普通股之權利。根據本公司普通股之收盤價，發行給西南股東之本公司普通股總價值約為 79 億美元。有關進一步討論，請參閱本報告第二部分第 8 項所附之財務報表附註第 2 項。

於2024年10月1日，本公司自S&P Global Ratings（"S&P"）取得投資等級評級。S&P對本公司無擔保債務給予發行者級別評級為"BBB-"，並將本公司發行者信用評級提升至"BBB-"，展望為穩定。此外，於2024年10月2日，本公司自Fitch Ratings（"Fitch"）取得投資等級評級。Fitch維持本公司循環信貸評級為"BBB-"，並將本公司高級債券評級提升至"BBB-"，展望為穩定。此外，於2025年4月16日，本公司自Moody's Ratings（"Moody's"）取得投資等級評級。Moody's將本公司高級無擔保債券評級從Ba1提升至Baa3，展望為穩定。
於2025年3月，隨南西部合併完成及取得投資等級評級後，本公司普通股被納入S&P 500指數。

於2025年9月30日，本公司與貸款人簽訂修正並重述信貸協議，其中包含其他事項，將2025信貸融資的到期日從2027年12月延長至2030年9月，並提供兩次一年期延長選擇權，每次延長需貸款人同意；將2025信貸融資下的總承諾金額從25億美元增至35億美元，並增加額外承諾金額至最高10億美元，需取得承諾及符合常見條件。信貸協議亦將發票信貸額度上限從5億美元增至10億美元，並將循環貸款額度上限從5千萬美元增至1億美元。有關進一步討論，請參閱本報告第二部分第8項所附財務會計彙編附註第4項。
發行高級債券及高級債券償還

於2024年12月，本公司完成發行7.5億美元本金金額的5.70%高級債券（"2035債券"）之公開承銷發行。此外，本公司宣佈以現金購買所有現有2026債券（"贖回要約"）。在贖回要約到期後，約91%或4.53億美元的2026債券已有效提出且未有效撤回。於2024年第四季的另外一筆交易中，本公司以約3.12億美元贖回所有3.04億美元本金的SWN 2028債券，包含800萬美元的贖回 premiums。

於2025年1月，3.89億美元本金的SWN 2025債券以現金及先前信貸融資借款償還並終止。此外，於2025年3月，本公司以現金償還剩餘4.7億美元本金的2026債券。於2025年，本公司亦透過公開市場買回，以現金償還約1.03億美元的6.750%高級債券（到期日為2029年）、約6千萬美元的5.875%高級債券（到期日為2029年）及約6千2百萬美元的5.375%高級債券（到期日為2029年）。有關進一步討論，請參閱本報告第二部分第8項所附財務會計彙編附註第4項。

headings: 與本公司營運相關之風險
天然氣、石油及NGL價格波動極大，若價格持續偏低，將可能對本公司業務造成重大不利影響。
節能措施及技術進步可能降低天然氣及石油之需求。
有關本公司或本產業之負面公眾觀感，可能對本公司營運造成不利影響。
與潛在併購或資產處分相關之風險可能對本公司業務造成不利影響。
若商品價格下跌或鑽井作業未達成，本公司可能需對天然氣及石油資產之帳面價值進行減損記提。
本公司需投入大量資本支出以替代儲備並進行營運。
若本公司無法替代儲備，可能無法維持生產量。
實際的產量與未來的淨銷售額可能低於我們的預估。
我們的開發與探勘鑽井工作以及井的操作可能無法獲利或達成目標回報。
部分未開發的屬性可能受租約影響，若未在未來幾年內建立產能或續約，租約將到期。
天然氣與石油 operations 是不確定的，且涉及大量成本與風險。
我們的業務可能因管線、貨運與集輸系統容量限制而受影響，並可能遭遇中斷，進而影響現金流。
關鍵管理人員離職以及無法吸引與留住人才可能對我們的業務造成不利影響。
我們的業務面臨與災難、自然災害、極端天氣及無法控制的人為因素相關的風險，這些風險可能對我們的營運結果與財務狀況產生負面影響。
總體經濟、政治、商業或產業條件惡化可能對我們的營運結果、流動性與財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
我們可能無法以具吸引力的條件處置資產，並可能需保留某些事項的負債。
軍事及其他武裝衝突，包括恐怖活動，以及相關的價格波動與地緣政治不穩定，可能對我們的業務及營運成果造成重大且不利的影響。
與我們業務相關的財務風險
我們有相當大的資金需求，且我們在有利條件下取得資本與信用市場資金的能力，受到產業環境的限制。
paragraphs: 影響我們業務及營運結果的因素非常多，許多因素為我們所無法控制。以下為我們認為具有重大影響，且可能導致我們未來結果與目前預期產生重大差異的因素說明。上述所描述的風險並非我們所面臨的唯一風險。尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前我們尚未知悉或認為不具重大影響，也可能影響我們的業務運作。若上述任何風險實際發生，將可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運結果、現金流、儲備及/或償還債務及其他負債的能力造成不利影響，並導致我們證券的交易價格與流動性下降，您可能損失全部或部分投資於我們證券的金額。

我們的營業收入、營運結果、獲利能力、流動性、負債比率及成長與資本支出投資能力，主要取決於我們銷售天然氣、石油及NGL所獲得的價格。我們為替換儲備、維持產能及執行業務計畫，需投入大量支出。天然氣、石油及NGL價格偏低，可能對可用於資本支出、債務償還及債務重組的現金金額產生負面影響，並影響我們借款或籌措額外資金的能力，進而對我們的財務狀況、營運結果、現金流及儲備造成重大不利影響。此外，天然氣及石油價格低迷的時期，可能導致我們天然氣及石油資產的帳面價值減少，因需對已證實及未證實的資產進行減損認列。
天然氣、石油及NGL價格的波動可能源自我們無法控制的因素，包括：
•天然氣、石油及NGL的國內及全球供應，包括美國天然氣及石油儲備的庫存；
•消費者及工業需求的變化，包括因全球或國家健康事件及相關擔憂所產生的影響；
•替代燃料的價格與可取得性；•影響能源消耗的科技進步；
